Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly inferred that the paternal grandfather was "King Chulalongkorn (Rama V)" based on the search snippet which stated Nakkhatra Mangala was the "eldest son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana". The Planner failed to correctly identify that Kitiyakara Voralaksana is the grandfather's name, instead hallucinating that Voralaksana was a title or intermediate name that pointed to King Chulalongkorn as the actual grandfather. This is a logical error in reading the text: Nakkhatra Mangala (Father) -> Kitiyakara Voralaksana (Grandfather). The answer provided by the Planner (King Chulalongkorn) is factually wrong; the correct answer is Kitiyakara Voralaksana.
